environment.description: Staging deployment on EKS with the same Terraform provider backend. The Aurora PostgreSQL cluster uses a separate database role 'tf_provider_ro' provisioned via the RDS IAM authentication integration. The role was created with: CREATE ROLE tf_provider_ro LOGIN; GRANT SELECT ON tf_resources TO tf_provider_ro; No additional grants exist. The pg_hba.conf entry for this role specifies 'hostssl tfstate 10.0.0.0/16 md5' restricting connections to the VPC CIDR. Note: the application code references DB_USER env var which is set to 'tf_provider_ro' in the pod spec via a Kubernetes ExternalSecret synced from AWS Secrets Manager. The RDS parameter group has 'log_statement=all' and pgaudit extension logging DML. Row-level security is NOT enabled on the table itself.

config.db_grants: GRANT SELECT ON tf_resources TO tf_provider_ro
config.secret_management: AWS Secrets Manager via ExternalSecrets operator
